founding_date_audit.scope: This purge applies only to the museum's own founding/Est. date and tagline copy, not to a specimen's real-world first_outbreak year. content/specimens/m11-socially-awkward-penguin.json correctly has first_outbreak: 2009 — that is the meme's actual first-circulation year per the register, not a founding-date conflict.
founding_date_audit.result: No stray museum-founding-date references to 2002 or 2009 found in this repo's content or docs. The correction otherwise applies to the live site's own assets, which this repo does not contain.
